queries: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS appearance_count FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY p.bats) SELECT batting_hand, appearance_count, appearance_count * 1.0 / SUM(appearance_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, appearance_count * 1.0 / AVG(appearance_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average FROM hand_counts
